2609.02277.title: Auditory Illusion Benchmark for Large Audio Language Models
2609.02277.paper_summary: Perceptual illusions have long served as crucial probes into human cognition, revealing biases and limitations of perception. In the auditory domain, such illusions provide a unique lens for testing whether Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) replicate human perceptual tendencies. Despite their importance, most benchmarks focus on visual illusions or general audio tasks, leaving auditory illusions underexplored. To this end, we present AIB, the first auditory illusion benchmark for LALMs, covering ten representative illusions across music, sound, and speech, each annotated for the presence of knowledge-based priors. Our methodology pairs model evaluation with controlled human listening studies, enabling direct comparison of responses. Results show systematic differences: while most LALMs remain signal-faithful on low-level acoustic illusions, several exhibit more human-like responses when linguistic or musical priors are involved, although no model matches the human perceptual profile. These findings highlight the current limitations of LALMs as cognitive models. By establishing auditory illusions as a rigorous testbed, our work offers a new perspective for probing neural black-box models and advancing understanding of auditory cognition. AIB is publicly available at https://github.com/gillosae/aib.
2609.02277.paper_summary_zh: 感知幻覺長期以來一直是探究人類認知的重要工具，揭示了感知的偏見和限制。在聽覺領域，這些幻覺提供了一個獨特的視角，以測試大型音頻語言模型（LALMs）是否重現人類的感知傾向。儘管它們的重要性，現有的大多數基準測試集中於視覺幻覺或一般音頻任務，導致聽覺幻覺未受到充分探索。為此，我們提出了AIB，首個針對LALMs的聽覺幻覺基準，涵蓋音樂、聲音和語音中的十個代表性幻覺，每個幻覺都標註了知識基礎先驗的存在。我們的方法將模型評估與受控的人類聆聽研究相結合，使得反應的直接比較成為可能。結果顯示出系統性的差異：雖然大多數LALMs在低級聲學幻覺上保持信號忠實，但在涉及語言或音樂先驗時，幾個模型表現出更類似人類的反應，儘管沒有模型能夠匹配人類的感知特徵。這些發現突顯了LALMs作為認知模型的當前局限性。通過將聽覺幻覺建立為一個嚴謹的測試平台，我們的工作為探究神經黑箱模型和推進聽覺認知的理解提供了一個新視角。AIB已在 https://github.com/gillosae/aib 上公開提供。
